name: orions-frontier
description: A persistent idle world in space

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @orions-frontier/api && npm run build --workspace @orions-frontier/websocket && npm run build --workspace @orions-frontier/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:behavior: docker compose run --build --rm api npm run test:behavior --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:behavior
